_note: sm-minigames: C_Chem_1, the first Chemistry class (scripts/secnd/ClassChem.lua with F_SetStage(1); force-started by AreaScripts/SchoolHallways.lua once 1_02C has passed and C_Chem_1 has never been attempted -- here 1_02C chains straight into it). Beats: the class intro (Dr. Watts at _C4_TEACH, two students at _C4_STUDENTS, Jimmy walks in from _C4_P_DOOR, fade, Jimmy at the lab table _C4_P_TABLE under the _C4_CAMPATH06 camera looking at the flask), the minigame (Config/Minigames/ClassChem.json class 1: three runs, 'Get Ready' / 'Try Again' / 'Last Chance'; the third failure blows up), the grade screen and, on a pass, F_EndPresentation: back in the hallway at _C4_EXIT, PlayerSetWeapon(301, 3) = three firecrackers, the class-1 unlock (firecrackers from the dorm chem set), PlayerSetGrade(1, 1).
